chapters.title: SQUEEZE
chapters.text: Compression fell to 1.35 ATR, inside the 1.5 ATR squeeze channel: the squeeze is on, and the coil appears on the centerline. A release can fire only after 6 squeeze bars.

chapters.title: EARLY LONG
chapters.text: 12 bars into the squeeze the A wave hooks back up while the B and C waves hold above zero: the early entry, once per squeeze, on the ribbon before any fire.

chapters.title: FIRED LONG · GOOD
chapters.text: The 27-bar squeeze releases: compression 1.86 ATR clears the 1.65 release line with momentum 119 growing up. GOOD (ADX 30 not quiet, C wave on its side, B wave on its side), so the chevron prints at the low.

chapters.title: QUIET
chapters.text: The long run ends after 15 bars, 53 pts from the fire bar's close: momentum faded toward zero for two bars in a row. The fire chevron stays where it printed.
